estimates.assumptions: Standard large egg yolk is ~17g; uses known average calories for raw egg yolk.
1/3 cup chopped onion weighs ~53g based on standard volume-to-weight conversion for diced onion; using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
1/2 cup diced rutabaga (swede) weighs ~70g based on standard volume-to-weight for cubed root vegetables; using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
1/4 tsp ground pepper weighs ~0.5g based on typical density for ground spices; using supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
